answer: The violet multiplier is published, charged in lagoon, and ferrous lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 15 for every identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A farm of 2376 identities would post 1714 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
